root_cause.text: Fraglist GRO/GSO segmentation in the networking stack wrongly let skb_segment_list process XLAT-translated GSO sk_buffs without marking them SKB_GSO_DODGY, even though bpf_skb_proto_4_to_6()/bpf_skb_proto_6_to_4() translate only the head skb header and leave frag_list entries potentially untranslated.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states “skb_segment_list cannot correctly process GRO skbs that have been converted by XLAT, since XLAT only translates the header of the head skb” and the patch fixes this by setting `shinfo->gso_type |= SKB_GSO_DODGY` in `bpf_skb_proto_4_to_6`/`bpf_skb_proto_6_to_4`, plus adding `!(... & SKB_GSO_DODGY)` checks before calling `__tcp*_gso_segment_list()` and `__udp_gso_segment_list()`.

Author: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
